account.pitch: A Subsurface account backs up your logbook and shares it between your devices, and with Subsurface on a computer. It is free.

createText.one: Your dive is sent to it; a confirmation code arrives by email
createText.other: Your {n} dives are sent to it; a confirmation code arrives by email

account.signIn: Sign in to an existing account

signInText.other: Your {n} dives are added to the account's dives, without overwriting anything

account.autoSyncOff: Off: changes stay on this device, and those from other devices do not arrive, until you sync

welcome.title: OpenDives
welcome.intro: Your dive logbook, on your phone and tablet. How do you want to start?
welcome.existing: I already have a Subsurface account
welcome.existingText: Your dives are backed up in the Subsurface cloud. A copy stays on this device: you can read it without a network, and it is updated when the network is back.
welcome.createText: Free. Your dives are backed up and shared between your phone, your tablet and your computer. You can bring your divelogs.de logbook into it.
welcome.noAccountText: Your dives stay on this device only: no backup, and no sharing with your other devices. You can create an account later and send your logbook to it.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.textNone: The logbook stays in the cloud. A copy stays on this device, not shown, and is used if you sign in again.

textPending.one: {n} change is not sent to the cloud yet. If you sign out anyway, it will be sent the next time you sign in to this account, from this device.
textPending.other: {n} changes are not sent to the cloud yet. If you sign out anyway, they will be sent the next time you sign in to this account, from this device.

signOut.deleteCopy: Also delete the copy on this device
signOut.deleteCopyHint: Possible once the changes are sent
signOut.syncFailed: The changes could not be sent; you are still signed in.
signOut.failed: Signing out did not complete; nothing was deleted.

consequence.one: The account {email} and its dive will be deleted from the cloud, on all your devices and in every app that uses this account. There is no way to undo it.
consequence.other: The account {email} and its {n} dives will be deleted from the cloud, on all your devices and in every app that uses this account. There is no way to undo it.

deleteAccount.keep: Keep my dives on this device
deleteAccount.keepText: They move to a logbook without account, on this phone only
deleteAccount.export: Export a copy of the logbook
deleteAccount.exportText: A Subsurface file (.ssrf), to keep elsewhere
deleteAccount.passwordText: To confirm that it is you
deleteAccount.note: Changes not sent yet will be synced first, so that the copy kept is complete. The account is only reported deleted if the server confirms it.
deleteAccount.notDeleted: The account was not deleted; nothing changed.
deleteAccount.wrongPassword: This is not the account's password; nothing was deleted.

edit.title: Edit the dive
edit.durationNote: Computed by the dive computer; editable only for a dive logged by hand
edit.readOnlyNote: Fields in grey cannot be edited yet in this version.
edit.undoFailed: The change can no longer be undone
edit.failed: The change could not be saved; nothing changed.
edit.writeLocked: This account cannot be edited from OpenDives yet; nothing changed.

tripScreen.ungroupText: The dives stay in the logbook, outside any trip.
tripScreen.noOtherTrip: No other trip in the logbook
tripScreen.noLooseDive: Every dive is already in a trip
tripScreen.help: Each dive's menu removes it from the trip or splits the trip there. The top menu merges this trip with another, adds dives or ungroups the trip.

duplicatesLink.other: {n} possible duplicates: clean up the sites

sites.name: Name
sites.movePin: Move the map under the pin
sites.noDevicePosition: The device's position is not available

withoutIntro.one: {n} dive has no site. OpenDives suggests the site of the other dives of the same trip.
withoutIntro.other: {n} dives have no site. OpenDives suggests the site of the other dives of the same trip.

sites.cleanupIntro: Imports sometimes create the same site several times. Merging keeps a single site, with all its dives. It can be undone.
sites.sameNameAt: Same name apart from case, {n} m apart
sites.mergeText: “{keep}” keeps all the dives of “{other}”, which goes away. It can be undone.

unusedIntro.one: {n} site is not used by any dive. They often come from imports or deleted dives.
unusedIntro.other: {n} sites are not used by any dive. They often come from imports or deleted dives.

deleteText.one: The selected site will be deleted. No dive is affected. It can be undone.
deleteText.other: The {n} selected sites will be deleted. No dive is affected. It can be undone.

sites.placeExplain: Country and region follow the position when it changes, unless you corrected them. Offline, they come from a built-in map, less precise.
sites.nearbyShort: A site already exists within 100 m: {site}.
sites.unplacedIntro: These sites have dives but no position. Open one to place it on the map.
sites.deleteSiteHint: The dives that use it stay in the logbook, without a site. You will be asked to confirm.

deleteSiteText.one: The dive that uses it stays in the logbook, without a site. It can be undone.
deleteSiteText.other: The {n} dives that use it stay in the logbook, without a site. It can be undone.

sites.deleteSiteTextUnused: No dive uses it. It can be undone.
